description: PIN Appl 1 is disabled, so files protected by PIN1 are open to anyone holding the card
reference: ETSI TS 102 221 clauses 9.5 and 11.1.1.4.10 (PIN status); 3GPP TS 31.102 clause 4
remediation: enable PIN1 (key reference 01) on the application, or confirm the universal PIN is enabled and in use, then re-scan
